content: SFSpeechRecognizer authorization requires NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription in Info.plist and SFSpeechRecognizer.requestAuthorization; user permission dialog cannot be triggered on the CarPlay screen itself — the permission prompt surfaces on iPhone, and system alerts cannot be presented from a CarPlay scene; on-device recognition (requiresOnDeviceRecognition) avoids the ~1-minute audio segment limit imposed on server-based recognition and works without network. CarPlay guidelines require all flows possible without interacting with iPhone — so first-run permission requests must be handled on phone before driving. Apple docs pages are JS-rendered; this digest is from established platform knowledge, MEDIUM confidence.
